title: Red apple
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow under apple -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='28' ry='6' fill='#3a1a2a'/>
  <!-- main apple body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='30' ry='32' fill='#e83030'/>
  <!-- left blush / lighter red highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='50' rx='12' ry='18' fill='#ff5a4a'/>
  <!-- right side deeper shade -->
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='60' rx='14' ry='22' fill='#c41e2a'/>
  <!-- bright highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='42' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#ff8a7a' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- top dip -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='27' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#c41e2a'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='48' y='14' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#7a4a20'/>
  <!-- stem highlight -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='14' width='2' height='12' rx='1' fill='#a06830'/>
  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M52 20 Q64 10 72 16 Q66 24 54 24 Z' fill='#3aaa40'/>
  <!-- leaf vein / highlight -->
  <path d='M54 22 Q62 16 69 16' stroke='#7ae080' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
